title: Shadow Glen Stables
specs: Scenic trails with views of Lake Natoma, Nimbus Dam, and wildlife including deer, coyotes, and hawks
Trails include hills, wooded and open areas, not flat pasture rides
Riders must wear closed-toed shoes that lace up or boots (no crocs, clogs, slip-ons, or UGGs)
All riders under 18 must wear a helmet (provided)
Riders 15 years or younger must be accompanied by an adult participant
No double riding allowed for safety reasons
All riders must have reservations; no walk-ins
Group events available for tour groups, corporate events, birthdays, scout troops, school field trips

services.name: Riding Lesson
services.desc: Join us and learn the basics of Western Trail Riding in a private, one hour

includes: Helmets provided at no cost for all riders under 18 and encouraged for all riders
Hay fed twice daily for boarded horses
Access to miles of state park trails, arenas, round pen, wash racks, and tack storage for boarded horses
gap: Age minimum for trail rides not stated explicitly
blurb: Guests can enjoy guided horseback trail rides along the American River at Lake Natoma with certified wranglers. They offer private riding lessons, summer camps for kids, and horse boarding with access to state park trails and arenas. The facility emphasizes safety, proper horse care, and a variety of riding experiences for all skill levels.
extraNote: Please bring cash or Venmo to tip your Wrangler if you have a great experience! · Trail rides require 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule for full refund · Lessons require 48 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule for full refund · Camps require 48 hours' notice or valid doctor's note for refund · No-shows or late cancellations will be charged the full cost of the ride · Rides may be canceled or rescheduled due to high temperatures, heavy rain, or heavy wind; no charge if canceled by operator
